bifrost: springboard/src/shell/login.rs (password-only login UI, Backend trait); springboard/src/privd/auth.rs (password check)
summary: Apple's framework is one graphical view (LAAuthenticationView) that shows the state of biometric authentication. BifrOSt has no biometric authentication, so there is nothing for this view to reflect. The login screen is a custom password-only UI, which is the nearest counterpart to a custom authentication view.

features.note: The icon state machine picks a key for each biometry kind and state, and a sensor name maps to its kind (unknown names map to nothing). Headless tests: ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-11.rs (a_sensor_name_picks_its_biometry_kind_and_nothing_else, an_auth_view_follows_a_failed_then_successful_attempt). Gap: no biometric state source feeds the events and no SDK view draws the icon; both need the local authentication service and a check on Midget. Built 2026-10-17: LocalAuthenticationView (springboard/sdk/src/view/local_auth_view.rs) wraps the AuthView model as a tappable icon; tests view::local_auth_view::tests. The biometric source is still missing.

features.feature: Creating the view from an authentication context
features.note: Pure model: an authentication context runs one evaluation for a policy on a device, records the biometric failure count, and maps its phase to the view state (AuthContext::presentation: prompt, unavailable reason, outcome or closed). Tests: springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-tests-08.rs (context_*), springboard/core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-46.rs and the auth_context unit tests. The icon view that the context's events drive is springboard/ui/src/auth_view.rs (AuthView); its own tests are not counted here. Gap: no LAContext-style object is exposed to apps, springboard/sdk/src/ has no biometric module, and nothing is verified on Midget.

features.feature: Sizing the view with a control size
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 3 (theme-05, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. depends on the view above

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/login.rs (Login, Backend, parse_reply, parse_lock_message); springboard/src/privd/auth.rs (lockout_secs, parse_hint, parse_fails); docs/privd-protocol.md
features.note: The login window's name, hint, lockout and reply handling and the privd lockout and hint rules are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-01.rs. Gap: only password checks run through privd, with no biometric or paired-device unlock.

gaps: No biometric authentication in the system layer, so there is no state for LAAuthenticationView to show (docs/bifrost-ui.md, Login window gaps: "no biometric or paired-device unlock").
No SDK API equivalent to an authentication context or to LAAuthenticationView, and no control size token for it.
The login screen password flow (springboard/src/shell/login.rs) is the only authentication UI; it cannot show biometric state until a biometric source exists.
